text.text: Engine: Enhanced id Tech 3 Source Port | Original Hardware: IBM PC Compatible | Media: Original Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory Game Data | Graphics: OpenGL Hardware Rendering | Sound: Digital Audio | Resolution: 640×480p Original with Modern High-Resolution and Widescreen Support

text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: ET: Legacy is an open-source continuation of Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory, a multiplayer first-person shooter originally released in 2003. Built from the original id Tech 3 engine source code, it improves compatibility with modern systems while preserving the team-based gameplay, classes, objectives, and competitive features of the original. ET: Legacy adds updated rendering, improved stability, modern display support, bug fixes, and continued community development.
